# open_trash_bin — realism QA repair

Straight black body, thin metal collar, inward-sloping annulus and open aperture; actuator unseen.

## Evidence and numerical review

Three original calibrated frames: f5008, f5016, f5026. Mean silhouette IoU 0.8914. Photo contours are hand traced, with approximately 2–4 px uncertainty at 256 px crop resolution. Explicit masks exclude selected occluders. Wire masks additionally use a dark-pixel threshold. This is not certified segmentation ground truth.

Comparison: [photo / render / overlay](../review/open_trash_bin_compare.jpg). Full calibration, masks and measurements: `../review/open_trash_bin/`.

Grades: evidence=B, silhouette=B, proportions=B, colour_texture=B, articulation=C, physics=C, collision=B, instances=B

## Changes

- Added three original calibrated photo crops, traced photo masks and numerical comparisons.
- Added explicit mass basis/uncertainty, constituent density, material-specific friction, restitution, COM prior and fragility.
- Replaced rounded toroidal-looking top with a flatter, inward-sloping steel opening ring.
- Replaced five fat sectors with 48-sector thin walls and separate rim contacts.
- Corrected circular-section size and instance placement from three photos.
- Kept stainless top as a separate movable lift-off lid candidate and explicitly recorded unresolved actuation.
- Fixed rim/body contact overlap exposed by a failed drop test; added an internal seating ledge and radial clearance.

## Remaining

- No lid actuation appears in the reviewed frames; lift-off vs internal swinging mechanism is not established.
- Requested real lid mechanism therefore remains unresolved; no invented rear hinge was certified.
- Inner bag liner, hidden back and exact product mass remain unverified.
- Real present mass, friction, restitution and stiffness have not been measured; physics values are explicit priors.
